after.notes: Current institution master states recruitment for Phase IB Kubanda mammary cryotherapy. Individual official flyer requires histopathologic mammary cancer, no prior treatment of the lump or chemotherapy for other cancers, and systemic fitness. Cryotherapy is followed a few weeks later by surgical mass removal. Other investigational treatment, concurrent study enrollment and life-threatening medical/immunosuppressive illnesses exclude entry. Detailed team screening remains required.
after.special_requirement: Histopathologic mammary cancer; no prior treatment of this lump or chemotherapy for other cancers; no concurrent study/investigational therapy or major life-threatening illness. before.center: University of Missouri Veterinary Health Center
before.title: COTC027 — TdCyd / Aza-TdC hypomethylating nucleosides in tumor-bearing dogs
before.why: Missouri's live Current Clinical Trials roster explicitly says it is enrolling dogs into COTC027.
before.intervention: Investigational hypomethylating nucleosides TdCyd and Aza-TdC
before.funding: Fully funded after eligibility: the study covers all treatments and rechecks, including initial staging and treatment of adverse effects.
before.notes: Dogs >=15 kg. Histologically confirmed lymphoma or solid tumor. Solid tumors must be non-sarcomatous, >=3 cm, biopsy-accessible, with accessible draining node. Lymphoma requires nodal stage >=2 with at least three nodes >=3 cm. Broad catalog fallback is used, but detailed prescreen is required.

sites.name: University of Missouri College of Veterinary Medicine
